subtests.name: navigator.install("") rejects with TypeError for empty install URL.
navigator.install("://invalid") rejects with TypeError for invalid URL.
navigator.install(url, "") rejects with TypeError for empty manifest ID.
navigator.install("   ") rejects with TypeError for whitespace-only URL.
navigator.install(url, null) rejects with TypeError for null manifest ID.
navigator.install(url, undefined) rejects with TypeError for undefined manifest ID.
navigator.install({}) rejects with TypeError when manifest is missing.
navigator.install({manifest: ""}) rejects with TypeError for empty manifest URL.
navigator.install({manifest: "://invalid"}) rejects with TypeError for invalid manifest URL.
navigator.install({manifest, id: ""}) rejects with TypeError for empty id.
navigator.install({manifest, id: "://invalid"}) rejects with TypeError for invalid id.
